arguments.hypothesis: With the structure fixed at the newly evaluated point (structure_identity a609999274528b34741e5d29c1fc861d420d315c6585df26019c7dfc16d44c33; components/near/length_m=0.16, components/far/length_m=0.11, design/material_scenario=compliant, design/section_scale=0.95) and control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight held at the source value 0.05, raising control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight from the source value 0.0 to the two finite points 0.05 and 0.1 produces a detectable, ordered change in holding_max_speed_m_s across the two previously unevaluated points while joint_reach_holding acceptance and terminal reach remain satisfied on this fixed structure.
arguments.rationale:
FINITE ADAPTATION RULE: begin from the exact source candidate batch-e4843b561ebaea27-0 (execution bebcafd47274940fb88a55ce5a2457c4c; configuration artifact 3535b142e00a10ceee822fa9ef5661dac3e5e1ada46c5b9a25ced8d80773574c), which is the newly evaluated structure (structure_identity a609999274528b34741e5d29c1fc861d420d315c6585df26019c7dfc16d44c33) already carrying controller/recipe holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0 and terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.05. Freeze structure and all undeclared fields (robot = every undeclared structural field, including components/near/length_m=0.16, components/far/length_m=0.11, near ellipse semi_y 0.0095/semi_z 0.0076, far rectangle sections, design/material_scenario=compliant, design/section_scale=0.95; task; acceptance; controller_implementation controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0; other_numerical_settings = control_period_s 0.01, 35 control updates, 0.05 s holding window, unchanged solver/horizon). Vary exactly ONE factor: control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight, taken at the finite ordered list {0.05, 0.1}, with control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight frozen at the source value 0.05. Both points are previously unevaluated on this structure and distinct from the source; the one-factor design directly tests the ordering of holding_max_speed_m_s versus holding weight. Only these two permitted paths are touched; candidate objects contain precisely the single varied builder path.

COMPARISONS: candidate points are compared against (a) the pre-adaptation changed structure = this source (weights 0.0/0.05, joint_reach_holding_passed=true, holding_max_error_m 0.002737, holding_max_speed_m_s 0.012736, terminal_error_m 0.002705); (b) the original research source batch-43a6daab7e3c1ce6-3 (execution 50618bf23b31464ba4f84c55cd26d1ca, 0.15 m structure, holding 0.0/terminal 0.05, holding_max_speed_m_s 0.035567, holding_speed_passed=false); and (c) the retained baseline baseline-replay (execution cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef, weights 0.0/0.0, joint_reach_holding_passed=false). This is bounded adaptation, not global optimization; local ranking uses candidate-specific solves and does not alter the final physical ranking.

EVIDENCE SCOPE: the only supplied aliases are the performed-check result aliases F1, F10, F100. The stated hypothesis is a proposed test, not an achieved result; no physical improvement is claimed before execution. Observations (source passes; earlier holding-only weights failed on the prior structure), hypotheses (holding weight orders holding speed on this structure) and proposed tests (the two points above) are distinguished. Claims of dominant cause or range-wide ineffectiveness are avoided; scope is the two tested points on one fixed structure under simulation.

BUDGET/COVERAGE: planned_budget.backend_solves equals the phase cap = number of new points (2); max_backend_attempts=2 and target_changed_configurations=2; other limits cover study_packet.budget.requirement (model_calls 5, tool_calls 13, wall_s 2590.0, worker_calls 0) and stay within study_packet.budget.available. One shared cumulative campaign, no reset; historical stopped campaign stays stopped; correction caps preserved. Reused starts/duplicates are recorded separately and consume no invented new-result quota.
stopping_conditions: Stop when the planned one-or-two-point batch reaches the declared completed changed-configuration target with sealed evaluations.
Stop on unknown or material failure, or insufficient delivery capacity.
Do not stop merely because the source recipe already passes holding.
Raw termination/deadline-miss counts do not by themselves trigger stop or acceptance.
weakening_observations: On the earlier 0.15 m structure the holding-only branch at weights 0.05, 0.1 and 0.3 all failed holding speed (holding_max_speed_m_s 1.175, 1.363, 1.128 m/s), so added holding weight alone previously did not resolve holding speed; the same weight direction may again fail.

The source recipe itself already passes (holding 0.0 / terminal 0.05: joint_reach_holding_passed=true, holding_max_error_m 0.002737, holding_max_speed_m_s 0.012736, terminal_error_m 0.002705), so added holding weight may be neutral or harmful (position/terminal tradeoff) rather than improving.
Zero force_bound_violation_n (0.0 at the source) does not exclude legal near-bound inputs, so force-bounds satisfaction cannot be inferred from the metric alone.

A two-point batch on one fixed structure under simulation cannot establish monotonic ordering across the whole weight range; termination/deadline-miss counts (35 at source) are a separate raw-termination/policy observation, not acceptance.
